no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Raphael Pharmaceutical is a preclinical-stage cannabinoid (CBD-based) R&D company. Lead candidate HPC1 (highly purified cannabinoid formulation) for rheumatoid arthritis is at proof-of-concept / preclinical stage with planned Phase 1/2 trials at Rambam Medical Center (Israel); asthma and oncology candidates are also preclinical. No active Phase 1/2/3 trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov or other public registries as of snapshot date.
